cars.variant: RZ six-speed manual — Japan October 2021 launch
cars.specification_market: Japan production launch of October 28, 2021; RZ six-speed manual reference. The year field identifies the Japanese launch year, not a North American model-year designation. Manufacturer output is 173 kW (235 PS) at 7000 rpm and 250 Nm at 3700 rpm. Displacement 2.387 litres is converted exactly to 2387 cc by multiplying by 1000. Shared engine/chassis fields and the manual gearbox are selected; AT-only launch EyeSight/SPORT mode, optional GR PARTS, other-market output, acceleration, weight and grade-specific tyres are not imported. The second-generation BRZ counterpart remains within this one programme.
cars.summary: The GR86 advances the lightweight, front-engine/rear-drive 86 sports-coupe concept with a larger 2.4-litre boxer, a newly developed body and increased rigidity while retaining a six-speed manual and driver-focused chassis. It represents the second-generation Toyota/Subaru 86/BRZ road programme, distinct from the original 2.0-litre GT86 already preserved. Count this shared generation once; Subaru badges, grades, transmissions, anniversaries and model years do not add separate entries.
